import sys

def main():
    nets = {}
    vats = {}
    for line in sys.stdin:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("#"):
            continue
        parts = line.split(";")
        if len(parts) != 4:
            continue
        desc, qty_str, price_str, rate_str = parts
        try:
            qty = float(qty_str)
            price = float(price_str)
            rate = float(rate_str)
        except ValueError:
            continue

        if qty <= 0:
            continue

        amount = round(qty * price, 2)
        if rate in nets:
            nets[rate] += amount
            vat = round(amount * rate / 100, 2)
            vats[rate] += vat
        else:
            nets[rate] = amount
            vat = round(amount * rate / 100, 2)
            vats[rate] = vat

    rates = sorted(nets.keys())
    total = 0.0
    for rate in rates:
        net = nets[rate]
        vat = vats[rate]
        print(f"{rate}% net {net:.2f} vat {vat:.2f}")
        total += net + vat

    print(f"total {total:.2f}")
    payable = round(total * 20) / 20
    print(f"payable {payable:.2f}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
